disposition: No request cache, aggressive-caching scope, conditional-revalidation consumer, or change-driven eviction exists anywhere in src/, crates/, or host/ — the only caches in src/ are query plan-selection caches, not document response caches. GAP-D01 routes this capability SDK-side under PD-2026-08-26-12 (engine supplies freshness primitives only: head/conditional load, publication events), but the SDK repositories remain untouched by charter, so there is no behavior and nothing to test in this tree.
